checkpoint_review: I agree with the Router's assessment of all checkpoints. The device clearly fits the 'hand-held computer' class, confirmed by the expert classifier (Top-1: hand-held computer). The form factor, screen, navigation pad, and material are all correctly identified as present. The Router correctly marked ports and stylus slot as untestable due to the viewing angle. No checkpoints were missed or misjudged.
artifact_review: The Router identified text illegibility (severity 2) and navigation pad fusion (severity 1). I agree with these findings. The image_text_auditor confirms text issues, extracting only 'CID' with low confidence, supporting the 'garbled text' observation. The perceptual_quality_auditor adds a new finding: moderate compression artifacts (severity score 0.4), noting pixelation and lack of fine detail. This was missed by the Router. The topology_boundary_auditor shows high mask confidence (0.9889), indicating good overall boundary integrity, but this does not negate the internal structural/text artifacts. I am upgrading the artifact severity slightly to account for the combined effect of text gibberish, button fusion, and compression noise.
alignment_reasoning: 7/7 testable checkpoints passed. Expert classifier strongly confirms class alignment (logit 7.89 vs 3.86 for next candidate). All functional and geometric requirements met within visible constraints.
key_defects: Illegible/garbled text on screen and buttons
